mapper.select: SELECT m.dmc_id, xt.para_id, -- 단락 ID (참조용) xt.para_title, -- 단락 제목 (General, 구조 등) CAST(xt.para_content AS TEXT) as para_content -- 단락 내부의 실제 텍스트 및 하위 태그들 FROM csdb_data_modules m, XMLTABLE('//*[local-name()="description"]/*[local-name()="levelledPara"]' PASSING m.content COLUMNS para_id TEXT PATH '@id', para_title TEXT PATH '*[local-name()="title"]', -- para 태그들을 텍스트로 합쳐서 가져오거나 XML 통째로 가져옴 para_content XML PATH '.' ) xt WHERE m.dmc_id = #{dmcid}

SELECT json_build_object( 'dmc', dmc_id, 'metadata', ( SELECT row_to_json(xt) FROM XMLTABLE('/dmodule/identAndStatusSection' PASSING content COLUMNS techName TEXT PATH 'dmAddress/dmAddressItems/dmTitle/techName', infoName TEXT PATH 'dmAddress/dmAddressItems/dmTitle/infoName', security TEXT PATH 'dmStatus/security/@securityClassification' ) xt ), -- 본문(content) 태그만 쏙 뽑아서 문자열로 전달 'body_xml', (xpath('//*[local-name()="content"]', content))[1]::text )::text as ietm_data FROM csdb_data_modules WHERE dmc_id = #{dmcid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO csdb_data_modules ( dmc_id, content, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{dmcId}, #{xmlContent}::xml, NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (dmc_id) DO UPDATE SET content = EXCLUDED.content, updated_at = NOW()
